mapper.select: SELECT J.id, J.company_member_id, COALESCE(J.company_name, C.company_name) AS company_name, J.title, J.job_category, J.employment_type, J.location, J.salary_min, J.salary_amount, J.salary_type, J.work_type, J.experience_level, J.education_level, J.description, J.requirements, J.preferred_qualifications, J.accessibility_info, J.wheelchair_accessible, J.accessible_restroom, J.disabled_parking, J.rest_area_available, J.elevator_available, J.assistive_device_support, J.accessibility_verified, J.source, J.external_job_id, J.contact_number, J.entry_type, J.managing_agency, J.recruitment_start_date, J.external_apply_date, J.external_registered_date, J.deadline, J.status, J.created_at, J.updated_at FROM job_posting J LEFT JOIN company_profile C ON C.member_id = J.company_member_id WHERE J.status = 'OPEN' AND (J.deadline IS NULL OR J.deadline >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY J.created_at DESC, J.id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT J.id, J.company_member_id, COALESCE(J.company_name, C.company_name) AS company_name, J.title, J.job_category, J.employment_type, J.location, J.salary_min, J.salary_amount, J.salary_type, J.work_type, J.experience_level, J.education_level, J.description, J.requirements, J.preferred_qualifications, J.accessibility_info, J.wheelchair_accessible, J.accessible_restroom, J.disabled_parking, J.rest_area_available, J.elevator_available, J.assistive_device_support, J.accessibility_verified, J.source, J.external_job_id, J.contact_number, J.entry_type, J.managing_agency, J.recruitment_start_date, J.external_apply_date, J.external_registered_date, J.deadline, J.status, J.created_at, J.updated_at FROM job_posting J LEFT JOIN company_profile C ON C.member_id = J.company_member_id WHERE J.id = #{id} AND J.status != 'DELETED'

SELECT J.id, J.company_member_id, COALESCE(J.company_name, C.company_name) AS company_name, J.title, J.job_category, J.employment_type, J.location, J.salary_min, J.salary_amount, J.salary_type, J.work_type, J.experience_level, J.education_level, J.description, J.requirements, J.preferred_qualifications, J.accessibility_info, J.wheelchair_accessible, J.accessible_restroom, J.disabled_parking, J.rest_area_available, J.elevator_available, J.assistive_device_support, J.accessibility_verified, J.source, J.external_job_id, J.contact_number, J.entry_type, J.managing_agency, J.recruitment_start_date, J.external_apply_date, J.external_registered_date, J.deadline, J.status, J.created_at, J.updated_at FROM job_posting J LEFT JOIN company_profile C ON C.member_id = J.company_member_id WHERE J.company_member_id = #{companyMemberId} AND J.status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY J.created_at DESC, J.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_posting ( company_member_id, company_name, title, job_category, employment_type, location, salary_min, salary_amount, salary_type, work_type, experience_level, education_level, description, requirements, preferred_qualifications, accessibility_info, wheelchair_accessible, accessible_restroom, disabled_parking, rest_area_available, elevator_available, assistive_device_support, accessibility_verified, source, deadline, status ) VALUES ( #{companyMemberId}, #{companyName}, #{title}, #{jobCategory}, #{employmentType}, #{location}, #{salaryMin}, #{salaryAmount}, #{salaryType}, #{workType}, #{experienceLevel}, #{educationLevel}, #{description}, #{requirements}, #{preferredQualifications}, #{accessibilityInfo}, #{wheelchairAccessible}, #{accessibleRestroom}, #{disabledParking}, #{restAreaAvailable}, #{elevatorAvailable}, #{assistiveDeviceSupport}, TRUE, 'LOCAL', NULLIF(#{deadline}, ''), 'OPEN' )

INSERT INTO job_posting ( company_member_id, company_name, title, job_category, employment_type, location, salary_min, salary_amount, salary_type, work_type, experience_level, education_level, description, requirements, preferred_qualifications, accessibility_info, wheelchair_accessible, accessible_restroom, disabled_parking, rest_area_available, elevator_available, assistive_device_support, accessibility_verified, source, external_job_id, contact_number, entry_type, managing_agency, recruitment_start_date, external_apply_date, external_registered_date, deadline, status ) VALUES ( NULL, #{companyName}, #{title}, #{jobCategory}, #{employmentType}, #{location}, #{salaryMin}, #{salaryAmount}, #{salaryType}, #{workType}, #{experienceLevel}, #{educationLevel}, #{description}, #{requirements}, #{preferredQualifications}, #{accessibilityInfo}, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, 'KEAD', #{externalJobId}, #{contactNumber}, #{entryType}, #{managingAgency}, NULLIF(#{recruitmentStartDate}, ''), NULLIF(#{externalApplyDate}, ''), NULLIF(#{externalRegisteredDate}, ''), NULLIF(#{deadline}, ''), 'OPEN' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE company_name = VALUES(company_name), title = VALUES(title), job_category = VALUES(job_category), employment_type = VALUES(employment_type), location = VALUES(location), salary_min = VALUES(salary_min), salary_amount = VALUES(salary_amount), salary_type = VALUES(salary_type), work_type = VALUES(work_type), experience_level = VALUES(experience_level), education_level = VALUES(education_level), requirements = VALUES(requirements), contact_number = VALUES(contact_number), entry_type = VALUES(entry_type), managing_agency = VALUES(managing_agency), recruitment_start_date = VALUES(recruitment_start_date), external_apply_date = VALUES(external_apply_date), external_registered_date = VALUES(external_registered_date), deadline = VALUES(deadline), status = 'OPEN', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE job_posting SET company_name = #{companyName}, title = #{title}, job_category = #{jobCategory}, employment_type = #{employmentType}, location = #{location}, salary_min = #{salaryMin}, salary_amount = #{salaryAmount}, salary_type = #{salaryType}, work_type = #{workType}, experience_level = #{experienceLevel}, education_level = #{educationLevel}, description = #{description}, requirements = #{requirements}, preferred_qualifications = #{preferredQualifications}, accessibility_info = #{accessibilityInfo}, wheelchair_accessible = #{wheelchairAccessible}, accessible_restroom = #{accessibleRestroom}, disabled_parking = #{disabledParking}, rest_area_available = #{restAreaAvailable}, elevator_available = #{elevatorAvailable}, assistive_device_support = #{assistiveDeviceSupport}, deadline = NULLIF(#{deadline}, ''), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND company_member_id = #{companyMemberId} AND status != 'DELETED'
UPDATE job_posting SET status = 'CLOSED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND company_member_id = #{companyMemberId} AND status = 'OPEN'
UPDATE job_posting SET status = 'DELETED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND company_member_id = #{companyMemberId} AND status != 'DELETED'
